name: GitHub MCP
tagline: Full GitHub API access for your AI agent.
shortDescription: Connect Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to GitHub. Create issues, open pull requests, search code, manage repositories, and review diffs — all from your agent.
longDescription:
## What it does

The official GitHub MCP server exposes the entire GitHub API as a set of tools your agent can call. Your agent can create issues, open PRs, search code across repos, manage branches, read files, and review diffs without you leaving the chat.

## Why we recommend it

It's the most-used MCP server in production today. The Anthropic team maintains it alongside the MCP spec, which means it tracks API changes faster than any community alternative. Authentication is a single GitHub PAT (or GitHub App for orgs).

## Common use cases

- Triage new issues automatically based on labels and content
- Search code across your org to find usages before refactoring
- Open PRs with AI-generated descriptions
- Read release notes and changelogs to draft summaries
- Auto-review PRs against your team's style guide
installInstructions:
1. Create a GitHub personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens (needs `repo`, `read:org`, `read:user` scopes)
2. Set the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable
3. Run the install command above
4. Add the server to your MCP client config (`~/.config/claude/config.json` for Claude Code)
pricingDetails: Free. Requires a free GitHub account; higher rate limits with GitHub Pro/Team.
